answer: Suppose an operator spins up 200 keys under one sponsor to capture attestation panels. Each panel of five is drawn by random beacon from the orchard, the registry of established identities, with at most one seat per grove, the invite subtree an identity descends from. All 200 keys share one grove, so they hold one seat and their chance of a 3-of-5 majority is zero. Panel rewards wait in a vault for four epochs and are burned for the whole grove if any member grades against the settled result.
